colortheme: A Unified Framework and Interface for Color Palettes and Ramps

Source: R/colortheme-package.R
colortheme-package.Rd

The 'colortheme' package provides a unified, environment-based object framework for managing, retrieving, and customizing color palettes and color ramps in R. It acts as a flexible dispatcher that supports both discrete qualitative palettes and continuous sequential/diverging color ramps. Features a compact URL-like syntax for on-the-fly theme modifications (such as color reversal, type coercion, and query-based parameter tuning) and seamless integration with base R graphics and 'ggplot2'.
